about.registryInfo: Recorded issuer is the listed parent, Coinbase Global, Inc. (NASDAQ: COIN). The specific issuing subsidiary for the tokenized-equity programme is not published as of 2026-08-14. It is NOT Coinbase Capital Markets Corp: CCM is the FINRA/SIPC broker-dealer behind coinbase.com/stocks, which serves US residents only, trades real shares with T+1 settlement and clears through Apex Clearing Corporation - the opposite jurisdiction and mechanism to the non-US tokenized product.
